summary: Learn the power of Knowledge Leadership and Change Enablement. Join our training course to enhance your skills and lead successful transformations.
lede: Knowledge leadership and change enablement help professionals preserve critical expertise and guide people through organizational change. For team leaders, change managers, knowledge specialists, and project or program managers, the training develops practical skills in mapping expertise, assessing stakeholder readiness, planning change activities, and capturing lessons to monitor adoption and improve implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly lead teams, shape processes, or support change initiatives, and who need to connect knowledge, people, and execution. This course is designed for: Change managers and change enablement leads. Knowledge management and learning specialists. HR and learning and development (L&D) professionals. Project and program managers driving transformation initiatives. Heads of departments and team leaders guiding staff through change. Strategy, planning, or innovation officers. Public sector and NGO staff responsible for reform or modernization projects. Business process owners implementing new systems or workflows. Internal communications professionals supporting change narratives. Anyone tasked with turning strategy, insights, and lessons learned into sustained behavior change.
modules: Measuring Impact of Knowledge and Change Initiatives
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of organizational processes and experience in team leadership or project management roles.
